results.name: modern-discovery-and-calls-without-initialize-or-session
results.expected: server/discover answers 2026-07-28 only, tools without listChanged, a 60 s private cache hint and the server's identity in result metadata; a tools/call on a fresh connection with no discovery or initialize before it scrapes the fixture as one JSON answer with resultType complete; the SDK client pinned to 2026-07-28 negotiates it by server/discover, never sends initialize, sends MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method equal to the body's method and Mcp-Name on each tools/call, with the envelope's revision on every request, and scrapes, maps, crawls, reads the crawl to completed and reads its receipt to SUCCEEDED; no answer anywhere carries Mcp-Session-Id; the MCP service logged these calls as modern 2026-07-28 for the validated client
results.actual: failed=none; SDK exchanges=15 (POST 15), methods=server/discover,tools/list,tools/call; raw answers checked for a session header=35; receipt=SUCCEEDED

results.name: malformed-missing-mismatched-metadata-rejected
results.expected: on the modern path: a missing MCP-Protocol-Version, a missing Mcp-Method, an Mcp-Method or Mcp-Name that disagrees with the body, and a header revision that disagrees with the envelope are 400 -32020; the modern header without the envelope and a malformed envelope are 400 -32602; an unsupported revision is 400 -32022; none of those eight JSON-bodied requests reached the server factory on either leg (the SDK's classification rejects them first), so none was served as a 2025-era request; a body that is not JSON is 400 -32700, answered by the SDK's legacy leg, which handles every non-JSON body, as its parse error; none of the nine reached the fixture and the MCP service logged no tool call for any of them, while the well-formed control reached the factory on the modern leg, reached the fixture and was logged (D5 obligation 1)
results.actual: cases=9, answered otherwise=none; JSON-bodied cases that reached the factory=none; the non-JSON body served on=legacy; the control served on=modern; fixture requests for rejected cases=0, for the control=1; codes=-32020,-32020,-32020,-32020,-32020,-32602,-32602,-32022,-32700

results.name: json-and-request-scoped-sse
results.expected: a modern call without a progress token is one application/json answer; the same call with a progress token is a text/event-stream answer carrying the progress notification with that token before the result; the MCP service logged that exchange as an event stream; 2025-era answers are streams; through Tailscale Serve the SDK client's progress call streamed and delivered its notification
results.actual: failed=none; JSON=application/json; progress call=text/event-stream messages=["notifications/progress","result"]; logged as text/event-stream; tailnet SSE exchanges=1

results.name: cancellation
results.expected: a modern tools/call with JSON-RPC id 0, aborted while the fixture held its page (the page started before the abort), is logged by the MCP service as cancelled with id 0, and the gateway logged its /mcp exchange and the MCP service's scrape call as 499 (D5 obligation 3); a 2025-era call whose connection closes mid-call is cancelled the same way; the 2025-era SDK client's notifications/cancelled is acknowledged and, served statelessly by another instance, is recorded with how the running call ended, ok when the notification reached another instance as stateless serving expects, or cancelled were it honoured (the spec promises no legacy return channel; the check records the limitation, it does not require it); firecrawl_cancel_crawl answers cancelled twice, the crawl and its receipt end CANCELLED with its completed pages archived and no slow page started more than 2.5 s after the cancel; cancelling a finished crawl is the gateway's 409 as a tool error
results.actual: failed=none; modern id 0 cancelled, gateway [{"status":499,"mcp_method":"tools/call"}]/499; legacy close cancelled; legacy notification: 1 acknowledged, call ok (ok: the notification reached another instance; cancelled: it was honoured); crawl CANCELLED archived=3, slow pages started after cancel+2.5 s=0 of 2; finished crawl=409

results.name: deterministic-catalog
results.expected: tools/list answers the manifest's nine tools sorted by name, byte-identical for two principals and both eras, and again from the SDK clients of both eras and after the MCP service was stopped and started; modern answers carry the 60 s private cache hint; each tool's annotations and argument names are the ones generated from the manifest (scrape: its route's fields less the gateway-set origin; crawl and batch: plus idempotencyKey); capabilities list the omitted tools with their not_enabled reasons; subscriptions/listen is refused -32603

results.name: two-independent-clients-and-owner-isolation

results.name: mcp-restart-between-crawl-and-status
